notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the receive-order Send Interaction predicates exercised by Umbra's non-installable development profile. It selects only active ordinary subscriptions; passive subscriptions remain declaration state but do not arrange callback delivery. The active/passive delivery predicate is stated in the standard's passive-subscription definition, while the Lab's immutable Clause 5.1.3 candidate records the required active-or-passive state. Ordinary rows are reused as foundational receive-order predicates for the process timestamped Receive/Evoke baseline; they do not claim timestamped queue, time-regulation, or retraction semantics. The timestamped-specific mapping is recorded in timestamped-interaction-requirements-contract.json. DDM regions, directed interactions, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, custom transportation, and all evidence promotion remain open. The public test uses a pre-existing IEEE-2025-schema fixture with Receive order and PublishSubscribe hierarchy; the private routing-kernel test additionally exercises the official Restaurant FOM hierarchy to cover descendant-parameter projection.
